svg.aria-label: Sky Batch architecture: a Python script calls ds.map() on a pool of workers. Input JSONL in cloud storage is split into batches and distributed across warm workers that span clouds and GPU types - worker 0 on an AWS L4, workers 1 and 2 on Nebius H200s. Results are written back to cloud storage by JsonWriter or ImageWriter.

g.text: one pool · workers can span clouds and GPU types
setup runs once per worker · the next ds.map() starts warm
Failed batches are retried and reassigned to healthy workers.
